feasibility_metadata.title: CycloneLM Phase 7: Hardware Feasibility and Adaptation Strategy Study
feasibility_metadata.project: CYCLONE INTEL — Coastal Karnataka Cyclone Preparedness

graphics_accelerator.operational_mode: Strict CPU Execution via PyTorch CPU engine

model_feasibility_matrix.verdict_reasoning: Trivial CPU and RAM usage, but incapable of generating syntactically valid JSON tools or fluent English prose due to 220:1 data starvation.
Runs end-to-end intent classification in under 10ms on CPU; training 1,000 steps takes ~1.5 minutes and uses <450 MB RAM.
Fits easily in memory and runs fast on CPU, but lacks modern instruction tuning, RoPE, and RMSNorm; generates poor structured responses.
Empirically measured at 80.7 tokens/s on our CPU. Both Full FT (2.7 GB) and LoRA (720 MB) fit easily inside 5.3 GB available RAM.

model_feasibility_matrix.hardware_verdict: Feasible with LoRA (Infeasible for Full FT)
model_feasibility_matrix.verdict_reasoning: Inference runs at ~20 tokens/s. Full FT (6.8 GB RAM) exceeds available memory, but LoRA (1.35 GB RAM) runs smoothly within safe limits.
Benchmark leader under 1B params. LoRA training uses only 1.85 GB RAM (leaving >3.4 GB free). Inference runs at 20.3 tokens/s with 32k context support.

model_feasibility_matrix.hardware_verdict: Marginally Feasible for Inference / Infeasible for Training
model_feasibility_matrix.verdict_reasoning: LoRA requires ~4.5 GB RAM (pushes available RAM to absolute limit); inference drops to <10 tokens/s; inferior quality to Qwen2.5-0.5B.
Exceeds physical RAM for training (requires >5.8 GB just for LoRA); inference produces significant UI latency (6.8 tokens/s); causes CPU thermal throttling.

strategy_a_full_fine_tuning.name: Full Parameter Fine-Tuning
strategy_a_full_fine_tuning.memory_multiplier: 16x parameter count in bytes (AdamW master weights, momentum, variance, gradients)
strategy_a_full_fine_tuning.hardware_feasibility: Infeasible for >=360M models on 5.3 GB available RAM; Feasible only for <=135M
strategy_a_full_fine_tuning.catastrophic_forgetting_risk: Very High on small domain datasets (overwrites foundational English grammar)
strategy_a_full_fine_tuning.modularity: None (requires saving full multi-gigabyte checkpoints for each version)

strategy_b_lora_peft.name: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (LoRA / DoRA)
strategy_b_lora_peft.memory_multiplier: Base weights frozen (FP32/BF16) + 16x adapter parameters in bytes
strategy_b_lora_peft.hardware_feasibility: Fully Feasible across all target models (135M, 360M, 0.5B)
strategy_b_lora_peft.catastrophic_forgetting_risk: Very Low (base model remains frozen, preserving syntax and instruction alignment)
strategy_b_lora_peft.modularity: High (adapters are 5-15 MB files, hot-swappable at inference time)
strategy_b_lora_peft.recommendation: PRIMARY RECOMMENDATION FOR LANGUAGE GENERATION ADAPTATION

strategy_c_quantized_inference_adapter_t.name: Quantized Inference (GGUF / INT8) with Adapter Fine-Tuning
strategy_c_quantized_inference_adapter_t.memory_multiplier: INT8 base weights (~1 byte/param) + LoRA adapter in FP32
strategy_c_quantized_inference_adapter_t.hardware_feasibility: Feasible via PyTorch INT8 Dynamic Quantization or llama.cpp CPU GGUF
strategy_c_quantized_inference_adapter_t.recommendation: Recommended for high-efficiency production serving if RAM constraints tighten

strategy_d_decoupled_intent_and_pretrain.name: Decoupled Architecture: Deterministic Intent Classifier + Pretrained LM Synthesis
strategy_d_decoupled_intent_and_pretrain.trainable_parameters_percentage: 100% on 22.7M intent encoder + 0.8% LoRA on 0.5B generative backbone
strategy_d_decoupled_intent_and_pretrain.memory_multiplier: Total Peak RAM < 2.3 GB (both models resident concurrently)
strategy_d_decoupled_intent_and_pretrain.hardware_feasibility: Fully Feasible, high safety margin, leaves >3.0 GB RAM free
strategy_d_decoupled_intent_and_pretrain.catastrophic_forgetting_risk: Zero on intent classification (discrete classes); Negligible on synthesis
strategy_d_decoupled_intent_and_pretrain.modularity: Maximum (tool execution is completely independent of language generation)
strategy_d_decoupled_intent_and_pretrain.recommendation: PRIMARY ARCHITECTURAL RECOMMENDATION (Optimal Safety, Quality, and Hardware Alignment)

runtime_resource_allocation_budget.temperature_and_thermal_guardrail: Allow 1-minute cooldown between back-to-back training runs if CPU temperature exceeds 75°C
